modes.name: EXPLICIT_OFFICIAL_ZIP
modes.detail: Runner may receive --ofcom-zip; the file must pass signature, minimum-size, CRC, zero all-premises r1 and exact 121 r2 gates.

modes.name: VALIDATED_LOCAL_CACHE
modes.detail: A previously downloaded cache is reused only after the same full ZIP validation; invalid cache is not trusted.

modes.name: PYTHON_URLLIB_PROXY_AWARE
modes.detail: Uses HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY and NO_PROXY through Python ProxyHandler; DNS probe failure does not pre-empt a proxy attempt.

modes.name: CURL_OR_CURL_EXE
modes.detail: Uses redirect handling, retries, connect timeout, total timeout and a fixed verifier user agent.

modes.name: POWERSHELL_INVOKE_WEBREQUEST
modes.detail: Uses TLS 1.2, redirect and timeout controls as the final network client.

modes.name: ZIP_AND_TRUTH_GATES
modes.detail: 10/10 deterministic tests; no business row, score, DB, migration or deployment flag can become true.

modes.name: DIRECT_ZIP_MEMBER_STREAM_NO_EXTRACTION
modes.detail: After ZIP validation, 121 corrected CSV members are read directly with zipfile.open; no CSV extraction directory, per-member SHA256/CRC evidence, global schema and uniqueness gates; 20/20 new local tests.
